subject: Execution & migration cadence — AurumCloud MAP (canary gates + training)
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@aurumcloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18 09:12 PDT
Subject: Execution & migration cadence — AurumCloud MAP (canary gates + training)

Hi Sophie —

Congrats again on signing. Attached is the first draft of the MAP that embeds our post-signature execution plan (deployment sprints, canary gates, migration windows, and training schedule). Key asks from your side so we can start week-of-4/26:

- Confirm the two pilot accounts (dev & staging) we should target for the canary.
- Confirm preferred weekly cadence for cutovers (Tues/Thurs 9–11am PT or Wed 1–3pm PT).
- Identify the primary DevOps point-of-contact for runbook sign-off (we'll need an SLA on incident handoffs during the canary).

High-level plan in the spreadsheet:
- Week 1 (canary prep): environment access, baseline perf, verification tests
- Week 2 (canary 1): 1% traffic, monitoring window, rollback test
- Week 3 (canary 2): 10% traffic, training of ops, runbook dry-run
- Week 4 (migration): full cutover for subset, post-cutover evaluation

I've attached the spreadsheet (AurumCloud_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short checklist (canary-validation-checklist.pdf). Laura will lead the training curriculum and Marissa will coordinate success metrics.

If you prefer, we can run a 30-min alignment call on Monday (4/19) at 10am PT — propose accepting or suggest an alternate.

Thanks,
Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: AurumCloud_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), canary-validation-checklist.pdf (pdf)

From: Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@aurumcloud.com>

Date: 2027-04-18 10:03 PDT
Subject: Re: Execution & migration cadence — AurumCloud MAP (canary gates + training)

Vivek —

Thanks for the clear plan and congrats on getting this moving. Couple quick answers:

- Pilot accounts: staging-account-2 and internal-dev-01 are fine for the initial canary.
- Cadence: Wed 1–3pm PT works best (our ops lead has standing availability).
- DevOps POC: forwarding to our lead (cc'd) — they will be primary for runbook sign-off.

We reviewed the MAP spreadsheet briefly; procurement asked to confirm the 30-day escalation SLA in the contract (line item 6.2). I'll loop procurement if we need an exception.

Monday 4/19 at 10am PT won't work for us, but Wed 4/21 1pm PT is good for an alignment call — suggest a 45-min slot to walk through the canary checklist and training plan.

Appreciate the attachments.

Best,
Sophie

--
Sophie Tan
VP Engineering, AurumCloud
sophie.tan@aurumcloud.com | +1 (650) 555-4321

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-19 08:45 PDT
Subject: Re: Execution & migration cadence — AurumCloud MAP (canary gates + training)

Hi Sophie —

Happy to take lead on training. A few notes based on the MAP:

- Training modules: Ops runbook, incident playbook, model-behavior monitoring, cost controls. I attached a provisional training-rollout-schedule.csv (see attachments) with recommended cohort sizes (10–12 engineers/class) and required pre-reads.
- Hands-on: propose two 90-min labs during Week 3 aligned with Canary 2 (one for DevOps, one for App Owners).
- Certification: we'll produce a short checklist for runbook sign-off; DevOps must confirm acceptance prior to Canary 2.

Sophie — can you confirm the attendee list for the labs by EOD Monday so we can finalize material?

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: DevOps Team <devops@aurumcloud.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@aurumcloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20 14:22 PDT
Subject: Re: Execution & migration cadence — AurumCloud MAP (canary gates + training)

Laura / Vivek —

We (Aurum DevOps) reviewed the canary checklist and have two items that need clarity before sign-off:

1) KV-cache persistence strategy during migration — we prefer a 30-minute warm-up window after cutover so caches rehydrate before traffic ramp.
2) Rollback window: we need an automated fallback trigger at 15% error-rate sustained for 5 mins (we can provide the Grafana alert).

We've uploaded a short runbook snippet and proposed Grafana alert to the Drive folder (link in prior email). Once you update the canary checklist to reflect the warm-up window and alert thresholds, we can sign off and nominate the runbook approver.

Thanks,
Aurum DevOps (on behalf of Michael Park)

--
Attachment referenced: devops-runbook-snippet.md

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Tan <sophie.tan@aurumcloud.com>, DevOps Team <devops@aurumcloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-22 16:02 PDT
Subject: Re: Execution & migration cadence — AurumCloud MAP (canary gates + training)

Thanks all — quick update and agreed next steps: 

- I've updated the MAP spreadsheet to include the 30-minute cache warm-up and the 15%/5-min Grafana rollback trigger (new tab: "Canary-Rollback-Rules"). Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AurumSharedMAP
- Laura: please incorporate the warm-up and alert thresholds into the training lab materials and the runbook checklist.
- Marissa / Ben: we'll finalize success metrics (latency P95 target, error-rate ceilings, and cost delta thresholds) this week; please prepare a short scoring rubric.
- Sophie: confirm attendee list for the two Week 3 labs by Monday 4/26 EOD so Laura can publish materials.
- Next call: Wed 4/21 1pm PT — agenda will be canary checklist review, training plan, and runbook sign-off. I'll send calendar invite.

If procurement needs the SLA language now, Ben can own a short note to your procurement contact.

Appreciate the quick back-and-forth — momentum looks good.

Best,
Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
